facts.text: John described the energy in the room as infectious and mentioned that the group had great ideas, brainstormed together, and stayed motivated.

evidence.quote: The best part was the energy in the room - so infectious! We all had great ideas, brainstormed together, and stayed motivated.

facts.text: John stated that the motivated people around him gave him renewed energy and a purpose, inspiring him to make a bigger difference.

evidence.quote: The motivated people around me gave me renewed energy and a purpose. It really inspired me to make a bigger difference.

facts.text: John mentioned that talking with a group of people who were enthusiastic about tech for change made him think they could make a difference.

evidence.quote: Talking with the group of people who were as stoked as me on tech for change was awesome! It made me think we really can make a difference.

facts.text: John mentioned planning a trip to the East Coast.

evidence.quote: I'm planning a trip to the East Coast.
